correctness.rationale: Functional calculus gives 0≤X−X²≤I/4 and hence forward invariance under 0<B≤2I. If X is fixed and C=B⁻¹, then CXC=X−X². An eigenvector v with Xv=v would give XCv=0 and therefore ⟨v,Cv⟩=0, impossible. Thus X−X² has support S=ran X. Invertibility gives ran(CXC)=CS, so C reduces S. On S, X is invertible and the positive matrix X^(1/2) C X^(1/2) has square X²(I−X). Its unique positive square root is X(I−X)^(1/2), yielding C=(I−X)^(1/2) on S and the asserted commuting projection formula, including X=0. Conversely each eligible projection satisfies the equation. Ranks in each eligible eigenspace index the compact Grassmannian components. In a common eigenbasis the Hermitian derivative has real multiplier b_i b_j(1−x_i−x_j) on each real coordinate. An omitted b>1 produces b²>1, so only the fully occupied X_* can attract exponentially. Its inactive and mixed multipliers are strictly subunit under the proposed condition. On the active square [1,√3]² the multiplier b/a+a/b−ab decreases strictly in each argument, with opposite corners 1 and −1; hence all interior pairs are strictly inside. Frobenius norm diagonalization and derivative continuity give a local contraction, with equivalent estimates in any fixed matrix norm. The uniform exponential estimate, differentiated for each iterate at the fixed point, forces spectral radius <1, which rules out b=1, b=√3, and b>√3 via diagonal modes. No boundary behavior slower than exponential is ruled out by this argument.
residual_risks: Finite rational examples do not verify the all-dimensional theorem; the argument is analytic.

value.rationale: This is a complete equilibrium classification of an established noncommutative dynamical map in a natural coupling regime. It distinguishes repetition-induced fixed manifolds from genuinely noncommuting fixed points and proves that unequal-eigenvalue perturbations cannot silently tighten the scalar local threshold. The exact criterion simultaneously treats nonattraction, degeneracy, and both neutral boundaries.
residual_risks: The significance is rigidity and local exponential stability, not a global convergence or chaos theorem.
